name: Cyril Morlet
title: Software Engineer — Blockchain Data & Distributed Systems · Java & Rust · ex-Bitfinex
summary: Engineer with 12 years building distributed systems around blockchain data. Built and operate a Rust chain indexer in production: streams checkpoints (sui-indexer-alt-framework, axum, tokio) into Redis 8 JSON/search serving sub-second reads; authored sui-checkpoint-reader, an open-source library for processing chain checkpoint files. At Bitfinex I owned RPC-level chain integrations: JSON-RPC clients, reorg handling, finality thresholds, fee accounting on deposit/withdrawal data pipelines — reliability where bugs lose customer funds. On the JVM: a live Java 25 game server (83K+ lines, 1,300+ users, solo-operated). JavaScript/TypeScript primary for a decade. Datalake formats (parquet/iceberg) I have not used yet — I learn infrastructure fast, in production.
